title: Venezulan Paella
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish made with saffron-infused rice, crispy vegetables, and a touch of nutty flavor.
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until crispy.
Add the chopped vegetables and cook until tender.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat with oil.
Add the paella spices, salt, and 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped almonds and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional crispy onions if desired.
